Overview.Name: M Soujanya Pradeep
Overview.Goal: Improve appearance, energy levels, mental wellbeing, and support steady fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables (no brinjal, pumpkin, potato)
Option 2: Curd bowl + cooked vegetable side
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + rajma curry + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + kabuli chana curry + vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Vegetable curry (no brinjal, pumpkin, potato) + small portion plain rice + curd
Option 3: Rajma curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid brinjal, pumpkin, and potato completely as per preference.
Keep fried foods limited as they trigger overeating.
For social gatherings, eat curd or paneer before going.
Maintain consistent meal timing to support energy and mood.
Simple cooked meals support digestion and long-term consistency.
Focus on body shape, confidence, and energy rather than only weight.
